title: Cathedral Stained Glass Woodland Fox Tough Phone Case | Gothic Stained Glass Dual-Layer Cover
description:
Protect your phone in premium artisan style with the Cathedral Stained Glass Woodland Fox Tough Phone Case.

Designed for the Gothic Stained Glass collection, this case combines high-impact shock absorption with edge-to-edge full-bleed artwork that will not fade, scratch, or peel.

PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS:
- Dual-layer protection: Impact-resistant Polycarbonate outer shell + Shock-absorbing TPU silicone liner
- Full-bleed 300 DPI sublimation printing with rich saturated pigments
- Engineered camera bezel with 35% upper safe zone protection
- Wireless charging (Qi & MagSafe compatible)
- Available for Apple iPhone & Samsung Galaxy flagship models

CARE INSTRUCTIONS:
Wipe clean with a damp microfiber cloth. Mild soap may be used if needed.
prompt: Full-bleed 9:16 vertical phone case artwork. Masterpiece gothic stained glass cathedral vitrail. Peaceful sleeping red woodland fox curled serenely in lower composition. Upper 35% safe zone holds a radiant amber cathedral sunburst window. Glowing autumn oak leaves and red fly agaric mushrooms. Heavy leaded came outlines, jewel-toned glass. Zero mockups, pure artwork.
